decisions: Finding, low, confirmed, high confidence (TC-6): the unit run prints An update to Root inside a test was not wrapped in act from the main entry test, which leaves its React root mounted. A developer notices it in verbose output; tests still pass
Finding, low, confirmed, high confidence (TC-7): npm run test:e2e builds the app again after CI has built it, so every CI run builds twice. Developers wait longer for CI; the result is correct

Finding, low, confirmed, high confidence (TC-8): installed with npm legacy peer deps, the unit run fails with Cannot find package @testing-library/dom, as package.json does not list it. A developer with that npm setting cannot run the unit tests; default npm ci works
